chapters: Jano' ba' gu Adam gu Set gu Enos.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Maalaleel gu Jared.
Jano' ba' gu Enok gu Matusalem gu Lamek.
Jano' ba' gu Noee gu Sem gu Kâm gu Japet.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Japet; gio ba' gu Gomer gu Magog gu Dadai gu Jabaan gu Tubal gu Mesek gu Tiras.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gomer; gio ba' gu Askenas gu Ripat gu Togorma.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jabaan; gio ba' gu Elisa gu Tarsis gu Kîtim gu Dodanim.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Kâm; gio ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Misraim gu Put gu Kanaan.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Kûs; gio ba' gu Seba gu abila gu Sabta gu Raema gu Sabtekâ; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Raema; jano' ba' gu Seba gu Dedaan.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios jix mar gu Nimrod; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam kua'da' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu Misram jix mar gu Ludim gu Ananim gu Laabim gu Neptuim.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Kasluim; gio ba' suulhgia' moor gu Pilisteos gu Kaptoreos.
Jano' ba' gu Kanaan jix mar gu Sidoon maa'nkam mar.
Jano' ba' gu eteo gu Jebuseo gu Amorreo gu Gergeseo.
Jano' ba' gu ebeo gu Arakeo gu Sineo.
Jano' ba' gu Aradeo gu Samareo gu amateo.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sem; gio ba' gu Elam gu Assur gu Arpaxad gu Lud gu Aram gu us gu ul gu Geter gu Mesek.
Jano' ba' gu Arpaxad jix mar gu Sela jix mar gu eber.

Jano' ba' gu eber guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gook gu ma'nkam; na gu' gu tɨɨgɨ' maa'n ka't gu Peleg na gu' gu tanoolh ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu tɨɨgɨ' xibhɨk ka't gu Joktaan.
Jano' ba' gu Joktaan jix mar gu Elmodad gu Selep gu Asarmabet gu Jera.
Jano' ba' gu Adoram gio gu Usal gu Dikla.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Abimael gu Seba.
Jano' ba' gu Opir gu abila gu Jobab; gio ba' bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Joktaan.
Jano' ba' gu Sem gu Arpaxad gu Sela.
Jano' ba' gu eber gu Peleg gu Reu.
Jano' ba' gu Serug gu Nakôr gu Tare.
Jano' ba' gu Abraam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Abraam; gio ba' gu Isaak tu' gu Ismael.
Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' maa'nkam mar gu Ismael gu Nabajot; mi' dhɨr gu Kedar gu Adbeel gu Misam.
Jano' ba' gu Duma gu Maasa gu adad gu Tema gu Jetur gu Napis gu Kedma; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Ismael.
Jano' ba' gu Ketura guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Abraam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Simram gu Joksaan gu Medaan gu Madiaan gu Isbak gu Suua.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jobsaan; gio ba' gu Seba gu Dedaan.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Madiaan; gio ba' gu Epa gu Eper gu enok gu Abida gu Eldaa; mi' dhɨr bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Ketura.
Jano' ba' gu Abraam jix mar gu Isaak; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Isaak jix bɨɨx duu gu Esauu tu' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Esauu; gio ba' gu Elipas gu Reuel gu Jeus gu Jalam gu Kora.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Elipas; gio ba' gu Temaan gu Omar gu Sepi gu atam gu Kênas gu Timna gu Amalek.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Reuel; gio ba' gu Naat gu Sera gu Samma gu Missa.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Seir; gio ba' gu Lotaan gu Sobal gu Sibeoon gu Ana gu Disoon gu Eser gu Disaan.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Lotaan; gio ba' gu ori gu omam; mi' dhɨr gu Timna ka't gu ja'tkam gu Lotaan.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sobal; gio ba' gu Alian gu Manaak gu Ebal gu Sepi gu Oman; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Sibeom; jano' ba' gu Aia gu Ana.
Jano' ba' gu Disoon ka't gu mar gu Ana; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Disoon; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu esbaan gu Itran gu Kêraan.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Eser; gio ba' gu Bilam gu Saabaan gu Jaakaan; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Disaan; jano' ba' gu us gu Araan.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu oidha' gu Edom va'k guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Bela gu mar gu Beor; mi' dhɨr gu tɨɨgɨ' kiicham ka't gu Dinaba.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Bela jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Jobab gu mar gu Sera gu Bosra.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Jobab jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu usam gu oidha' gu Temanos.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu usam jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Adad gu mar gu Bedad naaka'n gu Madiaan vaak ja'tkam gu Moab; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' kiicham ka't gu Abit.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Adad jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Samla gu Masreka.
Jano' ba' jix koi gio gu Samla jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Sauul gu Reobot ju'ñdharan gɨ' suudai' jiim.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Sauul jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Baal-anaan gu mar gu Akbor.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Baal-anaan jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Adad gu tɨɨgɨ' kiicham ka't gu Pai; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu u'vɨ gu Meetabel mar u'vɨ gu Matred guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Mesaab.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Adad guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Edom; gio ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Timna guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Alia guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jetet.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Oolibama guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Ela guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Pinoon.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Kênas guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Temaan guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Mibsar.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Magdiel guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Iram; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Edom.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Rubeen gu Simeoon gu Lebii gu Judaa gu Issakâr gu Sabuloon.
Jano' ba' gu Dan gu Josee gu Benjamiin gu Neptalii gu Gad gu Aser.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Judaa; gio ba' gu Er gu Onaan gu Sela; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam vaik guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ mar u'vɨ gu Sua gu Kananea; jano' ba' gu Er maa'nkam mar gu Judaa ka't cham bhai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' gu Tamar guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Pares gu Sara; gio ba' bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Judaa jix bɨɨx duu jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Pares; gio ba' gu esroon gu amul.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sara; gio ba' gu Simri gu Etaan gu emaan gu Kalkol gu Darda; mi' dhɨr bɨx jixchamaam.
Na gu' gu mar gu Kârmi ka't gu Akâr guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Israeel na gu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.
Jano' ba' gu Asariia ka't gu mar gu Etaan.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu esroon; gio ba' gu Jerameel gu Ram gu Kêlubai.
Jano' ba' gu Ram jix mar gu Aminadab; gio ba' gu Aminadab jix mar gu Naasoon gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' gu Naasoon jix mar gu Salma jix mar gu Boos.
Jano' ba' gu Boos jix mar gu Obed jix mar gu Isaii.
Jano' ba' gu Isaii jix mar gu Eliab maa'nkam mar gook gu Abinadab gu Sima vaik.
Jano' ba' maakobh gu Natanael jixchamaam gu Radai.
Jano' ba' xijumai gu Osem kɨɨv gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' gu Sarbia gu Abigail jix bɨɨx duu sɨspidhi'ñ; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sarbia jix bɨɨx duu vaik; mi' dhɨr gu Abisai gu Joab gu Asael.
Jano' ba' gu Abigail jix mar gu Amasa gu taat ka't gu Jeter gu Ismaelita.
Jano' ba' gu Kaleb gu mar gu esroon jix mar gu Jeriot gu u'vɨ gu Asuba; gio ba' gu ma'nkam jix bɨɨx duu gu Jeser gu Sobad gu Ardoon.
Jano' ba' muukix gu Asuba jix bhɨɨ gu Kaleb guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ gu Eprata guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ur.
Jano' ba' gu ur jix mar gu Uri jix mar gu Besaleel.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr chɨbiapui gu esroon mar u'vɨ gu Makîr gu taat gu Galaad jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Segub.
Jano' ba' gu Segub jix mar gu Jair guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jɨ'dɨlh gu oidha' gu Galaad.

Jano' ba' gu Gesur gu Aram guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jɨ'dɨlh gu Jair gu Kenat bɨɨx taañpu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix duu; gio ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Makîr gu taat gu Galaad.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu esroon gu Kaleb gu Eprata gu Abia gu u'vɨ gu esroon guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Asur gu taat gu Tekoa.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jerameel maa'nkam mar gu esroon jix bɨɨx duu gu Ram maa'nkam mar gu Buna gu Orem gu Osem gu Akîa.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jerameel gu u'vɨ mɨmɨim gu Atara ka't gu naan gu Onam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ram maa'nkam mar gu Jerameel jix bɨɨx duu gu Maas gu Jamiin gu Akar.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Onam jix bɨɨx duu gu Sammai gu Jada; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sammai; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Abisur.
Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu u'vɨ gu Abisur ka't gu Abiail guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Abaan gu Molib.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Nadab; gio ba' gu Seled gu Apaim; mi' dhɨr gu Seled jix koi cham gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gu Isi ka't gu mar gu Apaim; gio ba' gu Sesam gu mar gu Isi; mi' dhɨr tu' gu mar gu Sesam gu Alai.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jada xibhɨk gu Simmai; gio ba' gu Jeter gu Jonataan; mi' dhɨr jix koi gu Jeter cham gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jonataan; gio ba' gu Pelet gu Sasa; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Jerameel.
Jano' ba' gu Sesaan cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Sesaan tu duukam gu Egipkio tɨɨgim gu Jara jix maa gu Sesaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ mar u'vɨ; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Atai.
Jano' ba' gu Atai jix mar gu Nataan jix mar gu Sabad.
Jano' ba' gu Sabad jix mar gu Eplal jix mar gu Obed.
Jano' ba' gu Obed jix mar gu Jeuu jix mar gu Asariias.
Jano' ba' gu Asariias jix mar gu eles guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Elasa.
Jano' ba' gu Elasa jix mar gu Sismai jix mar gu Sallum.
Jano' ba' gu Sallum jix mar gu Jekamiia jix mar gu Elisama.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Kaleb xibhɨk gu Jerameel jix bɨɨx duu gu Mesa maa'nkam mar ka't gu taat gu Sip; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Maresa gu taat gu ebroon.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu ebroon; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Tapua gu Rekem gu Sema.
Jano' ba' gu Sema jix mar gu Raam gu taat gu Jorkaam; gio ba' gu Rekem jix mar gu Sammai.
Jano' ba' gu Maoon ka't gu mar gu Sammai gu Maoon gu taat gu Bet-sur.
Jano' ba' gu Epa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Kaleb guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jix duu gu Mosa gu Gases; gio ba' jix duu jix mar gu Gases.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Joddai; gio ba' gu Regem gu Jotam gu Gesaan gu Pelet gu Epo gu Saap.
Jano' ba' gu Maakâ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Kaleb guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Sebet gu Tirana.
Jano' ba' gio guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Saap gu taat gu Madmanna gu Seba gu taat gu Makbena gu taat gu Giba; gio ba' gu Aksa ka't mar u'vɨ gu Kaleb.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Kaleb gu mar gu ur maa'nkam mar gu Eprata; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu taat gu Kîriat-jearim.
Jano' ba' gu Salma gu taat gu Bet-leem; gio ba' gu arep gu taat gu Bet-gader.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sobal gu taat gu Kîriat-jearim jix bɨɨx duu gu aroe tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Manaetitas.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Kîriat-jearim jix bɨɨx duu gu Itreos gu Puteos gu Samateos gu Misraiteos; gio ba' moor gu Soratitas gu Estaolitas.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Salma; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Netopatitas guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu vaak gu Joab tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Manaetitas gu Soraitas.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jabes jix bɨɨx duu gu Tirateos gu Simateos gu Sukateos; gio ba' gu Kineos tɨɨtɨs gu amat gu taat gu vaak gu Rekâb.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Dabii guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ebroon; gio ba' gu Amnoon maa'nkam mar gu Akînoam gu Jesreelita; mi' dhɨr gook gu Danieel gu Abigail gu Karmelo.
Jano' ba' vaik gu Absalom gu mar gu Maakâ mar u'vɨ gu Talmai gu gɨ'kora' gu Gesur; gio ba' maakobh gu Adoniias gu mar gu Aggit.
Jano' ba' jixchamaam gu Sepatiias gu Abital; gio ba' xijumai gu Itream gu Egla gu u'vɨ.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ebroon pai' jix gɨ'kora' kɨɨv guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn masaa'n; gio ba' gu Jerusalem jix gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ vaik guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam maakobh guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu Simma gu Sobab gu Nataan gu Salomoon gu Bet-sua mar u'vɨ gu Ammiel.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; gio ba' gu Ibaar gu Elisama gu Elipelet.
Jano' ba' gu Noga gu Nepeg gu Japia.
Jano' ba' gu Elisama gu Eliada gu Elipelet.
Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Dabii cham gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gio ba' gu Tamar ka't gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Salomoon ka't gu Roboam gu mar ka't gu Abiia ka't gu mar gu Asa gu mar ka't gu Josapat.
Jano' ba' ka't gu mar gu Joram gu mar ka't gu Okôsiias gu mar ka't gu Joas.
Jano' ba' ka't gu mar gu Amasiias gu mar ka't gu Asariias tu' gu mar guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jotam.
Jano' ba' gu mar ka't gu Akâs ka't gu mar gu Esekîas gu mar ka't gu Manasees.
Jano' ba' ka't gu mar gu Amoon gu mar ka't gu Josiiyas.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Josiiyas; gio ba' gu Joanaan maa'nkam mar gook gu Joakim vaik gu Sedekiias maakobh gu Sallum.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Joakim; gio ba' gu Jekôniias gu mar ka't gu Sedekiias.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jekôniias; gio ba' jix duu gu Salatiel.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Pedaiia gu Seneaser gu Jekamiia gu osama gu Nedabiia.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Pedaiia; gio ba' gu Sorobabeel gu Simi; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Sorobabeel; jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ananiias gu Selomit gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Mesullam; gio ba' gu asuba gu Oel gu Berekîas gu asadiia gu Jusabesed; mi' dhɨr jixchamaam bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu ananiias; gio ba' gu Pelatiias gu Jesaiias gu mar gu Repaiias gu mar gu Arnaan gu mar gu Obdiias gu mar gu Sekâniias.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Sekâniias ka't gu Semaiias; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Semaiias; mi' dhɨr gu attus gu Igeal gu Barias gu Neariias gu Sapat; jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Neariias jix bɨɨx duu dhi' ja'tkam vaik; gio ba' gu Elioenai gu Esekîas gu Asrikam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Elioenai jix bɨɨx duu dhi' ja'tkam kɨɨv; gio ba' gu Odabias gu Eliasib gu Palaiias gu Akkub gu Joanaan gu Dalaiias gu Anani.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Judaa; gio ba' jix duu gu esroon gu Karmi gu ur gu Sobal.
Jano' ba' gu Reaias gu mar gu Sobal jix mar gu Jaat; gio ba' gu Jaat jix mar gu Aumai gu Laad; mi' dhɨr dhi' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Soratitas.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu taat gu Etam; gio ba' gu Jesreel gu Isma tu' gu Ibdas; mi' dhɨr gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ja'tkam ka't gu aslelponi.
Jano' ba' gu Penuel ka't gu taat gu Gedor gu Eser gu taat gu usa; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu ur maa'nkam mar gu Eprata gu taat gu Bet-leem.
Jano' ba' gu Asur gu taat gu Tekoa guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gook gu u'vɨ maachim gu elea gu Naara.
Jano' ba' gu Naara guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Ausam gu eper gu Temeni gu Aastari; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Naara.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu elea; gio ba' gu Seret gu Jesoar gu Etnaan.
Jano' ba' gu Kos jix mar gu Anob gu Sobeba ja'tkam vaak gu Aarel gu mar gu Arum.
Jano' ba' gu Jabes ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu ja'tkam gu naan jup tɨɨt gu Jabes bham; na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jabes gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' tu jiim guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix duu gu oidha' tu' gu novɨ mai' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam u'ua'tɨda' cham bhai' cham guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' gu Kaleb xibhɨk gu Sua jix mar gu Makîr ka't gu taat gu Estoon.
Jano' ba' gu Estoon jix mar gu Bet-rapa gu Pasea gu Teinna gu taat kiicham gu Naas; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu chio'ñ gu Rekâ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Kenes; gio ba' gu Otniel gu Seraia; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Otniel; jano' ba' gu atat.
Jano' ba' gu Maonati jix mar gu Opra; na gu' gu Seraia jix mar gu Joab gu taat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tɨɨgim gu Karisim na gu' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone; gio ba' gu Iru gu Ela gu Naam; mi' dhɨr tu' gu mar gu Ela ka't gu Kenes.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jaleleel; gio ba' gu Sip gu Sipas gu Tirias gu Asareel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Esra; gio ba' gu Jeter gu Mered gu Eper gu Jaloon; mi' dhɨr gio jix mar gu Mariam gu Sammai gu Isba gu taat gu Estemoa.

Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ gu Judaiia guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jered gu taat gu Gedor gu eber gu taat gu Sokô gu Ikutiel gu taat gu Sanoa; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Betia mar u'vɨ gu Faraoon bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Mered.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu u'vɨ gu Odiias gu ja'tkam gu Naam jix bɨɨx duu gu taat gu Keila gu Garmi gu Estemoa gu Maakâti.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Simoon; gio ba' gu Amnoon gu Rinna gu mar gu anaan gu Tiloon; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Isi; jano' ba' gu Soet gu Bensoet.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sela gu mar gu Judaa; gio ba' tu' gu taat gu Lekâ gu Laada gu taat gu Maresa ja'tkam vaak gu vaak guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak gu Asbea.
Jano' ba' gu Joakim gu chio'ñ gu Kôseba gu Joas gu Sarap guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Moab gu Jasubi-leem gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu jix duu gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn mia'n guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' tu duukam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Simeoon; gio ba' gu Nemuel gu Jamiin gu Jarib gu Sera gu Sauul.
Jano' ba' gio gu Sallum gu mar gu Mibsam gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu amuel gu mar gu Sakûr gu mar gu Simi gu mar.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Simi jix bɨɨx duu mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; gu' gu ja'tkam cham chooto'n mui'x gu ma'nkam tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨx ja'tkam vaak na ja'p gu ma'nkam gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Beer-seba gu Molada gu asar-sual.
Jano' ba' gu Bala gu Esem gu Tolad.
Jano' ba' gu Betuel gu orma gu Siklag.
Jano' ba' gu Bet-markâbot gu asasusim gu Bet-birai gu Saaraim; gio ba' dhi' jix bɨɨx duu jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx ka'm oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' taañpu' jix bɨɨx duu gu Etam gu Ain gu Rimmoon gu Tokên gu Asaan jixchamaam gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn mi'p guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn dhi' jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx ka'm gu Baal; gio ba' dhi' ka't ba'bhak dhi' gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gu Mesobab gu Jamlek gu Josiiyas gu mar gu Amasiias.
Jano' ba' gu Joel gu Jeuu gu mar gu Josibias gu mar gu Seraiia gu mar gu Asiel.
Jano' ba' gu Elioenai gu Jakoba gu Jesoaiia gu Asaiias gu Adiel gu Jesimiel gu Benaiias.
Jano' ba' gu Sisa gu mar gu Sipi gu mar gu Alloon gu mar gu Jedaiia gu mar gu Simri gu mar gu Semaiias.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ñi'ook tɨɨtɨs guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix jai' gu vaak tattat.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx ka'm ba'k gu Gador bɨɨx ka'm tas buusñi guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Na gu' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu oidha' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ na gu' gu Kâm oi'ñka' va'k.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tɨɨtɨs gu tanoolh gu Esekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ vaak zel dhi' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ pai'; na gu' ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Simeoon jix bɨɨx duu gu kavɨk gu Seir guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Pelatiia gu Neariias gu Repaiias gu Ussiel gu ma'nkam gu Isi.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Amalek guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen maa'nkam mar gu Israeel na gu' ka't maa'nkam mar gu' na ja'p guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ dhim gu taat guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ma'nkam gu Josee gu mar gu Israeel; gio ba' cham ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm maa'nkam mar.
Na gu' na gu' gu Judaa ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan gu ja'tkam gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gu' jix duu guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam ka't gu Josee; mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen maa'nkam mar gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Pallu gu Esroon gu Karmi.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Joel; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu mar gu Gog gu mar gu Simi gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu Mikâ gu mar gu Rekaiia gu mar gu Baal gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu Beera gu mar ka't bhaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Tiglat-pilneser gu gɨ'kora' gu Asirios; gio ba' dhi' ka't gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu Rubenitas.
Na pai' dhuuk gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ko'kmarak guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm chiñia' gu Jeiel gu Sakâriias.
Jano' ba' gu Bela gu mar gu Asas gu mar gu Sema gu mar gu Joel guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Aroer bɨɨx ka'm gu Nebo gu Baal-meoon.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gio dɨr tas buusñi bɨɨx ka'm ba'k oidha' jix gaki dɨr gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Euprates; na gu' ga'ra' mui'x guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu oidha' gu Galaad.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu Sauul aichdhak bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu Agarenos ia'rɨ gu novɨ; gio ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ vaak zel bhaan bɨx gu vupui guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Galaad.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gad guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu oidha' gu Basaan bɨɨx ka'm gu Salka.
Jano' ba' gu Joel ka't gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu Basaan gook gu Sepaan gu Janai mi' dhɨr gu Sapat.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam bhaan guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tattat jix bɨɨx duu gu Mikâel gu Mesullam gu Seba gu Jorai gu Jakân gu Sia gu eber; gio ba' bɨx kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Abiail gu mar gu uri gu mar gu Jaroa gu mar gu Galaad gu mar gu Mikâel gu mar gu Jesiaii gu mar gu Jaddo gu mar gu Bus.
Jano' ba' gio gu Aii gu mar gu Abdiel gu mar gu Guni ka't gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu vaak tattat.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Galaad gu Basaan taañpu' bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Saroon bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam gu tanoolh gu Jotaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu tanoolh gu Jeroboam gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu Gad ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kutun kavɨk gu kuchii guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn u'u gat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm oo'm maakobh mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' chooto'n bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx gu Agarenos gu Jetur gu Napis gu Nodab.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bhaan gu Agarenos jix maa gu noobh bɨx bɨɨx mi'p; na gu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na gu' jix duu.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' jix ai guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' kakneer gook mambhɨɨx gɨ' buur guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.
Na gu' ia'rɨ mui'x guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na gu' bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jix duu bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu oidha' dɨr gu Basaan bɨɨx ka'm gu Baal-ermoon gu Senir gu kavɨk gu ermoon guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Jano' ba' dhi' jix bɨɨx duu ɨɨbhidham gu vaak tattat; gio ba' gu Eper gu Isi gu Eliel gu Asriel gu Jeremiiyas gu Odabia gu Jadiel gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu chio'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ' jix duu gu vaak tattat.

Gu' gu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tattat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam gu oidha' ka't gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ vupui bhaan.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Pul gu gɨ'kora' gu Asirios gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Tiglat-pilneser gu gɨ'kora' gu Asirios bhaan gu Rubenitas gu Gaditas ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu alad gu abor gu Ara gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Gosaan bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii; gio ba' gu Gersoon gu Koat gu Merari.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koat; gio ba' gu Amram gu Isar gu ebroon gu Ussiel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Amram; gio ba' gu Aaroon gu Moisees gu Mariam; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon; jano' ba' gu Nadab gu Abiuu gu Eleasar tu' gu Itamar.
Jano' ba' gu Eleasar jix mar gu Pinees jix mar gu Abisua.
Jano' ba' gu Abisua jix mar gu Bukki jix mar gu Ussi.
Jano' ba' gu Ussi jix mar gu Seraiias jix mar gu Meraiot.
Jano' ba' gu Meraiot jix mar gu Amariias jix mar gu Akîtob.
Jano' ba' gu Akîtob jix mar gu Sadok jix mar gu Akîmaas.
Jano' ba' gu Akîmaas jix mar gu Asariias jix mar gu Joanan.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Joanan jix mar gu Asariias guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu vaak gu Salomoon gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu Asariias jix mar gu Amariias jix mar gu Akîtob.
Jano' ba' gu Akîtob jix mar gu Sadok jix mar gu Sallum.
Jano' ba' gu Sallum jix mar gu ilkiias tu' gu ilkiias jix mar gu Asariias.
Jano' ba' gu Asariias jix mar gu Seraiia jix mar gu Josadek.
Na pai' dhuuk gu Josadek ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Judaa gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ gu Nabukodonosor.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii; gio ba' gu Gersoon gu Koat gu Merari.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon; gio ba' gu Libni gu Simi.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koat; gio ba' gu Amram gu Isar gu ebroon gu Ussiel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Merari; gio ba' gu Maali gu Musi; mi' dhɨr dhi' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Lebii bhaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' gu Gersoon; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu mar gu Joat gu mar gu Simma gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu Joab gu mar gu Iddo gu mar gu Sera gu mar gu Jeotrai gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koat; gio ba' gu Aminadab gu mar gu Koree gu mar gu Asir gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu Elkana gu mar gu Abiasap gu mar gu Asir gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu Taat gu mar gu Uriel gu mar gu Ussia gu mar gu Sauul gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Elkana; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Akîmot gu Elkana.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Elkana; gio ba' gu Sopai gu mar gu Naat gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu Eliab gu mar gu Jeroam gu mar gu Elkana gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Samueel; gio ba' maa'nkam mar gu Basni gu Abiiyas.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Merari; gio ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Libni gu mar gu Simi gu mar gu Ussa gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu Sima gu mar gu aggiia gu mar gu Assiia gu mar.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu Dabii jix maa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu'x guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios mi' dhɨr kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jɨɨpi'ñka'.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa vupui bhaan vaak zel vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut xoi'kam bɨɨx ka'm gu Salomoon gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem; gio ba' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam bɨɨx gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koat gu emaan guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu mar gu Joel gu mar gu Samueel.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Elkana gu mar gu Jeroam gu mar gu Eliel gu mar gu Toa.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Sup gu mar gu Elkana gu mar gu Maat gu mar gu Amasai.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Elkana gu mar gu Joel gu mar gu Asariias gu mar gu Soponiias.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Taat gu mar gu Asir gu mar gu Abiasap gu mar gu Kore.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Isar gu mar gu Koat gu mar gu Lebii gu mar gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' xibhɨk gu Asap ka't gu novɨ jix duu; gio ba' gu Asap gu mar gu Berakîas gu mar gu Sima.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Mikâel gu mar gu Baasiias gu mar gu Malkîas.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Atanai gu mar gu Sera gu mar gu Adaia.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Etaan gu mar gu Simma gu mar gu Simi.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Jaat gu mar gu Gersoon gu mar gu Lebii.
Gu' gu' gu ma'nkam gu Merari gu ja'tkam mi'p gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam maachim gu Etaan gu mar gu Kîsi gu mar gu Abdi gu mar gu Maluk.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu asabiias gu mar gu Amasiias gu mar gu ilkiias.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Amasai gu mar gu Bani gu mar gu Semer.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Maali gu mar gu Musi gu mar gu Merari gu mar gu Lebii.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu Lebitas jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhaan bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Gu' gu' gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨx tu duukam pai' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan gu Israeel jurtu'nka' bɨx gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duu.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon dhi' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Eleasar gu mar gu Pinees gu mar gu Abisua gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu Bukki gu mar gu Ussi gu mar gu Seraiias gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu Meraiot gu mar gu Amariias gu mar gu Akîtob gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu Sadok gu mar gu Akîmaas gu mar.

Na gu' dhi' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Koatitas na gu' ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu ebroon gu oidha' gu Judaa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ xikoolh.
Gu' gu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios kiicham taañpu' jix maa gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jix maa jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa maachim gu ebroon gu Libna bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Jatir gu Estemoa bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ilem bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Debir bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Asaan bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Bet-semes bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Benjamiin gu Geba bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Alemet bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Anatot bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koat guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix maa mambhɨɨx jɨ'dɨlh ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix maa bopxi'ñ gu Issakâr bopxi'ñ gu Aser bopxi'ñ gu Neptalii bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu Basaan guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jɨ'dɨlh.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Merari guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bopxi'ñ gu Rubeen bopxi'ñ gu Gad bopxi'ñ gu Sabuloon jix maa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Lebitas jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' jix maa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Judaa bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Simeoon bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam gu Koat jix maa jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bopxi'ñ gu Epraim.
Jano' ba' jix maa jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Sikêm bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu kavɨk gu Epraim gu Geser bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Jokmeam bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Bet-oron bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Ajaloon bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Gat-rimmoon bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu Aner bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Bilam bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ na ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koat guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon jix maa ja'tkam vaak ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu Golan gu Basaan bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Astarot bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Issakâr gu Kedes bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Dobrat bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Ramot bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Anem bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Aser gu Masal bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Abdoon bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Ukok bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Reob bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Neptalii gu Kedes gu Galilea bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Ammoon bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Kîriat-jearim bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Merari guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jix maa bopxi'ñ gu Sabuloon gu Rimmono bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Tabor bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu Jerikoo tas buusñi gu Jordaan jix maa bopxi'ñ gu Rubeen gu Beser oidha' jix gaki bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' gu Jasa bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Kêdemot bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Mepaat bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Gad gu Ramot gu Galaad bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Maanaim bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu esboon bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jaker bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Issakâr maakobh; gio ba' gu Tola gu Puua gu Jabsub gu Simroon.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Tola; gio ba' gu Ussi gu Repaiias gu Jeriel gu Jamai gu Jibsam gu Samueel ɨɨbhidham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tattat; mi' dhɨr gu Tola jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Dabii guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Ussi ka't gu Israiias; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israiias; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Obadiias gu Joel tu' gu Isiias; jano' ba' bɨx jixchamaam chiñia'.

Jano' ba' ka't bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tattat guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham; na gu' chooto'n mumua'da' gu u'vɨ tu' gu ma'nkam.

Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Issakâr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam kɨɨv mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin jix bɨɨx duu vaik; gio ba' gu Bela gu Bekêr gu Jediael.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Bela; gio ba' gu Esbon gu Ussi gu Ussiel gu Jerimot tu' gu Iri; mi' dhɨr jixchamaam ɨɨbhidham gu vaak guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ maakobh.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Bekêr; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Joas gu Elieser gu Elioenai gu Omri gu Jerimot gu Abiiyas gu Anatot gu Alemet; mi' dhɨr bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Bekêr.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ɨɨbhidham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu chichio'ñ jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Jediael ka't gu Bilaan; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Bilaan; mi' dhɨr gu Jebuus gu Benjamiin gu Aod gu Kênaana gu Setaan gu Tarsis gu Aisaar.

Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Jediael ɨɨbhidham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu Suppim gu uppim jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu ir; gio ba' gu usim gu mar gu Aer.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Neptalii; gio ba' gu Jaoel gu Guni gu Jeser gu Sallum gu ma'nkam gu Bila.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Manasees; gio ba' gu Asriel guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Sira; mi' dhɨr gio guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Makîr gu taat gu Galaad.

Jano' ba' gu Makîr jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ gu ja'tkam gu uppim gu Suppim gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Maakâ; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gook ka't gu Salpaad; mi' dhɨr gu Salpaad guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' gu Maakâ gu u'vɨ gu Makîr guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu mar jup tɨɨt gu Peres; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' xibhɨk ka't gu i'ii'ñ gu ma'nkam jix bɨɨx duu gu Ulam gu Rekem.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Ulam ka't gu Bedaan; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Galaad gu mar gu Makîr gu mar gu Manasees.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu Molekêt guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Iskôd gu Abieser gu Maala.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Semida jix bɨɨx duu gu Aiaan gu Sekêm gu Likki gu Aniam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Epraim; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Bered gu mar gu Taat gu Elada gu mar gu Taat gu mar.

Jano' ba' gu Sabad gu mar gu Sutela gu mar gu Eser gu Elad; na gu' gu' gu ma'nkam gu Gat guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios mii' dhɨr gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na gu' tɨɨtɨs jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Epraim gu taat guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mui'x gu tanoolh tɨɨtɨs gu ja'tkam bhai'x i'ii'ñ duu.

Jano' ba' baakɨk mi' dhɨr gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu mar jix dhaas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Beriia; na gu' ka't dhi' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix duu mar u'vɨ ka't gu Seera gu Bet-oron guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Ussen-seera.
Jano' ba' gu mar dhi' gu Beriia ka't gu Repa gu Resep gu Tela gu mar gu Taaan gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu Laadaan gu mar gu Ammiud gu mar gu Elisama gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu Nun gu mar gu Josuee gu mar.

Jano' ba' gu maa'nkar ba'bhak ka't gu Bet-el bɨɨx taañpu'; gio ba' bhaan tas buusñi gu Naaraan baasɨ'n tas gei'ñ gu Geser taañpu'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Sikêm bɨɨx taañpu' bɨɨx ka'm gu Asa taañpu'.

Jano' ba' baasɨ'n gu ma'nkam gu Manasees gu Bet-seaan bɨɨx taañpu' gu Tanak bɨɨx taañpu' gu Megiddo bɨɨx taañpu' gu Dor bɨɨx taañpu'; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix duu guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Josee gu mar gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aser; gio ba' gu Imna gu Isua gu Isui gu Beriia gu ja'tkam gu Sera.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Beriia; gio ba' gu eber gu Makîel ka't gu taat gu Birsabit.
Jano' ba' gu eber jix mar gu Japlet gu Semer gu otam gu Sua gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Japlet; gio ba' gu Pasak gu Bimal gu Asbat; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam gu Japlet.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Semer; gio ba' gu Ai gu Roega gu Jeubba gu Aram.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu elem xibhɨk; gio ba' gu Sopa gu Imna gu Selles gu Amal.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sopa; gio ba' gu Sua gu arnaper gu Sual gu Beri gu Imra.
Jano' ba' gu Beser gu od gu Samma gu Silsa gu Itraan gu Beera.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jeter; gio ba' gu Jepone gu Pispa gu Ara.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ulla; gio ba' gu Ara gu aniel gu Resia.

Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Aser ɨɨbhidham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ɨɨbhidham chiñia'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jɨɨ'ñdhidha' ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Benjamiin jix mar gu Bela maa'nkam mar gu Asbel gook gu Ara vaik.
Jano' ba' gu Noa maakobh gu Rapa jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Bela jix bɨɨx duu gu Addar gu Gera gu Abiud.
Jano' ba' gu Abisua gu Naamaan gu Aoa.
Jano' ba' gu Gera gu Sepupim gu uram.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Eud dhi' ja'tkam ɨɨbhidham tattat guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Gabaa jix bɨɨx duu bhaan gu Manaat.
Jano' ba' maachim; gio ba' gu Naamaan gu Akîas gu Gera; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan jix mar gu Ussa gu Aiud.
Jano' ba' gu Saaraim jix mar gu ma'nkam oidha' gɨ' gu Moab mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu usim gu Baara guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' jix mar gu Kôdes gu u'vɨ gu Jobab gu Sibias gu Mesa gu Malkâm.
Jano' ba' gu Jeus gu Sokîas gu Mirma; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam ɨɨbhidham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Gu' gu' gu usim jix mar gu Abitob gu Elpaal.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Elpaal; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Misam gu Semeb pai'x gu Ono gu Lot bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' gu Beriias gio gu Sema jix bɨɨx duu ɨɨbhidham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Ajaloon guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Gat.
Jano' ba' gu Aiio gu Sasak gu Jeremot.
Jano' ba' gu Sebadiias gu Arad gu eder.
Jano' ba' gu Mikâel gu Ispa gu Joa gu ma'nkam gu Beriias.
Jano' ba' gu Sebadiias gu Mesullam gu iskî gu eber.
Jano' ba' gu Ismari gu Islia gu Jobab gu ma'nkam gu Elpaal.
Jano' ba' gu Jakim gu Sikri gu Sabdi.
Jano' ba' gu Elioenai gu Silitai gu Eliel.
Jano' ba' gu Adaiias gu Baraiias gu Simrat gu ma'nkam gu Simi.
Jano' ba' gu Ispaan gu eber gu Eliel.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Sikri gu anaan.
Jano' ba' gu ananiia gu Belam gu Anatotiias.
Jano' ba' gu Ipdaiias gu Peniel gu ma'nkam gu Sasak.
Jano' ba' gu Samseri gu Seariias gu Ataliia.
Jano' ba' gu Jaarsiias gu Eliiyas gu Sikri gu ma'nkam gu Jeroam.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu Gabaoon guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Abiga-baoon gu u'vɨ jup tɨɨt gu Maakâ.
Jano' ba' gu mar maa'nkam mar gu Abdoon gu Sur gu Kîs gu Baal gu Nadab.
Jano' ba' gu Gedor gu Aiie gu Sekêr.
Jano' ba' gu Miklot jix mar gu Simea; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gio guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Ner jix mar gu Kis jix mar gu Sauul jix mar gu Jonataan gu Malkî-suua gu Abinadab gu Esbaal.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Jonataan ka't gu Merib-baal jix mar gu Mikâ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Mikâ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Melek gu Taarea gu Aas.
Jano' ba' gu Aas jix mar gu Joadda; gio ba' gu Joadda jix mar gu Elemet gu Asmabet gu Simri; mi' dhɨr gu Simri jix mar gu Mosa.
Jano' ba' gu Mosa jix mar gu Bina gu mar ka't gu Rapa gu mar ka't gu Elasa gu mar ka't gu Asel.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Asel jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Asrikam gu Bokru gu Ismael gu Seariias gu Obadiias gu anaan; gio ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Asel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Esek xibhɨk; gio ba' gu ñi'ook maa'nkam mar gu Jeus gook gu Elipelet vaik.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Ulam gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ chooto'n mui'x gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ chamaam mambhɨɨx; gio ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin.

Jano' ba' gu Kontado bɨx gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu Judaa jix bɨɨx duu bhaan gu Babiloonia guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' dharka' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm baap guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jɨ'dɨlh jix bɨɨx duu gu Israeel na ja'p jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas gu Netineos.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jerusalem gu ma'nkam gu Judaa gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu ma'nkam gu Epraim gu Manasees.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu mar gu Amiud gu mar gu Omri gu mar gu Imrai gu mar gu Bani gu ma'nkam gu Pares gu mar gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' gu Siloni gu Asaiias maa'nkam mar gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sara gu Jeuel gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin; gio ba' gu Sallu gu mar gu Mesullam gu mar gu Odabiia gu mar gu Asenua.
Jano' ba' gu Ibniias gu mar gu Jeroam gu Ela gu mar gu Ussi gu mar gu Mikri; gio ba' gu Mesullam gu mar gu Sepatiias gu mar gu Reuel gu mar gu Ibniias.

Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gio ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ jix bɨɨx duu ɨɨbhidham ja'tkam vaak gu vaak tattat.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' gu Jedaiia gu Joiarib gu Joakîm.
Jano' ba' gu Asariias gu mar gu ilkiias gu mar gu Mesullam gu mar gu Sadok gu mar gu Meraiot gu mar gu Akîtob gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Adaiias gu mar gu Jeroam gu mar gu Pasur gu mar gu Makîas; gio ba' gu Masai gu mar gu Adiel gu mar gu Jasera gu mar gu Mesullam gu mar gu Mesillemit gu mar gu Immer.

Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam ɨɨbhidham gu vaak tattat jɨɨ'ñdhidha' mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu chichio'ñ jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu duukam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Lebitas; gio ba' gu Semeiias gu mar gu assub gu mar gu Asrikam gu mar gu asabiias gu ma'nkam gu Merari.
Jano' ba' gu Bakbakkar gu eres gu Galal gu Mattaniia gu mar gu Mikâs gu mar gu Sikri gu mar gu Asap.
Jano' ba' gu Obadiias gu mar gu Semeiias gu mar gu Galal gu mar gu Idutum; gio ba' gu Berakîas gu mar gu Asa gu mar gu Elkana guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ taañpu' gu Netopati.
Jano' ba' tu jiim; gio ba' gu Sallum gu Akkub gu Talmon gu Aiman gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu Sallum ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm jano' tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu ma'nkam gu Lebii guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ dhi' ja'tkam tu jiim ki'ñgob gu gɨ'kora' tas buusñi.

Jano' ba' gu Sallum gu mar gu Kore gu mar gu Abiasat gu mar gu Kora gu ja'tkam gu Koraitas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak gu taat chooto'n guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu duukam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kiki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan; gio ba' tattat jix bɨɨx duu bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios nuuka'n ba'k.
Jano' ba' gu Pinees gu mar gu Eleasar ka't va'k guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Sakariias gu mar gu Meselemia ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.

Na pai' dhuuk bɨx dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ba' nuuka'n kiki'ñgob guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na pai' dhuuk jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Dabii gu Samueel guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu jiim kiki'ñgob gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Jano' ba' mi'p tu jiim maakobh jɨbɨɨlh tas buusñi tas gei'ñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn saagi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam mi'p taañpu' aajidha' kɨɨv gu tanoolh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨɨx.
Na gu' na gu' maakobh gu ñi'ook tu jiim gu Lebitas mi'p guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ko'kmarak guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix duu guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Na gu' dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam xikoolh gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na gu' ko'kmarak guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bhi'spio'kai guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' dhɨt dhi' ja'tkam ko'kmarak guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.
Jano' ba' ko'kmarak guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam xidhuu guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu' kubhion guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' dhɨt gu ma'nkam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.
Jano' ba' gu Matatiias maa'n gu Lebitas maa'nkam mar gu Sallum gu Koraita ga'ra' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu'x guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' dhɨt gu ma'nkam gu Koat gu ja'tkam ko'kmarak guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu takarui' tɨkiix guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam juanda'.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Lebitas mi'p jix duu guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; na gu' gu tanoolh gu tukaa' mi'p mii' dhɨr tu duukam.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Lebitas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ oi'ñka' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu Gabaoon oi'ñka' gu Jeiel gu taat gu Gabaoon gu tɨɨgɨ' gu u'vɨ ka't gu Maakâ.
Jano' ba' gu mar maa'nkam mar gu Abdoon gu Sur gu Kîs gu Baal gu Ner gu Nadab.
Jano' ba' gu Gedor gu Aio gu Sakâriias gu Miklot.
Jano' ba' gu Miklot jix mar gu Samaaan; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam oi'ñka' gio gu Jerusalem bɨɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Ner jix mar gu Kis jix mar gu Sauul jix mar gu Jonataan gu Malkîsua gu Abinadab gu Esbaal.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Jonataan ka't gu Merib-baal jix mar gu Mikâ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Mikâ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Melek gu Tarea gu Aas.
Jano' ba' gu Aas jix mar gu Jara jix mar gu Alemet gu Asmabet gu Simri; gio ba' gu Simri jix mar gu Mosa.
Jano' ba' gu Mosa jix mar gu Bina gu mar ka't gu Repaiia ka't gu mar gu Elasa gu mar ka't gu Asel.

Jano' ba' gu Asel guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' gu Asrikam gu Bokru gu Ismael gu Seraiia gu Obadiias gu anaan; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Asel.
Jano' ba' gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' jiboi'ññor vupui bhaan gu Israelitas ia'rɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu kavɨk gu Gilboa.
Jano' ba' gu Pilisteos bhiadat gu Sauul gu ma'nkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Pilisteos gu Jonataan gu Abinadab gu Malkîsua gu ma'nkam gu Sauul.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan gu Sauul guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix duu ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul kutun kavɨk; na gu' jix buusñi gu kuchii guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx na gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ xoi'kam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios tu'; na gu' gu' kutun kavɨk cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na gu' ga'ra' ɨɨbhi'ñ; jano' ba' gu Sauul jix bhɨɨ gu kuchii guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan.
Jano' ba' na ja'p kutun kavɨk jix ñi' gu Sauul jix koi gio guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan gu kuchii guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Sauul vaik gu ma'nkam; gio ba' bɨx gu vaak jix koi bɨɨma'n bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ bɨx gu Israeel oi'ñka' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Sauul gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm koko'kam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jɨ'dɨlh jiboi'ññor; gio ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' ka't bai'ñpu' gu tanoolh buimgidhak gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat koko'kam gu ñi'ook gu Sauul gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu kavɨk gu Gilboa.

Jano' ba' a'lhiok guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam mo'o gu ñi'ook mɨjɨ bɨx gu oidha' gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios na ba' jum duu guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam duiñxim gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu ñi'ook vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ mo'o vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Dagoon.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ bɨx gu Jabes gu Galaad gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Sauul.

Jano' ba' jix búup bɨx gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu chuukug gu Sauul gu chuukug gu ma'nkam aichdhak gu Jabes; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn o'oo bɨtaa'n guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jabes guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn kɨɨv gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' jix koi gu Sauul guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm uañi'ñ bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' kuiñcha guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bhaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Dabii gu mar gu Isaii.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' bɨx gu Israeel jum daa'ñ gu Dabii gu ebroon bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm no'ch gu'ch o'o gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn va'k jano' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Sauul guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' jix buusñi guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gio gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ja'tkam gu Israeel tu' ka' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu Israeel gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jix duu tɨɨtɨs bɨx daraa gu Israeel gu gɨ'kora' gu ebroon gu Dabii bɨɨx ñi'ook na jix bhaan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Dabii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ gu Samueel.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' ka't gu Dabii bɨɨx bɨx gu Israeel gu Jerusalem gu Jebus; gio ba' ka't gu Jebuseo guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam mii' dhɨr gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jebus gui'p gu Dabii; gio ba' cham ba'k guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gu' gu Dabii jix bhɨɨ gu kavɨk gu Sioon kiicham gu Dabii.

Jano' ba' gu Dabii ka't tu ñi'ook; na maa'n guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jebuseo ka't mo'o guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu Joab gu mar gu Sarbia jix tɨ'ɨ maa'n ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu kavɨk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga kiicham gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' jix duu kiicham xikoolh dɨr gu Millo bɨɨx ka'm mia'n; gio ba' gu Joab tu jiim guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios kiicham.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ ka't bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk gu Dabii guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bɨɨx bɨx gu Israeel na ba' tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' dhi' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' jix kavɨk gu Dabii guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' gu Jasobam gu mar gu akmoni guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ u'u kavɨk tu jiim bhaan vaik guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' bhaan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ka't gu Eleasar gu mar gu Dodo gu Aoita ka't vaik jix kavɨk.

Jano' ba' dhi' juruuñ bɨɨx gu Dabii gu Pasdammin kua' tɨtda:―Aañ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Pilisteos; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kai' vaas guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Pilisteos; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx jix gɨ' dodhia'.
Jano' ba' vaik guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jodai kavɨk gu Dabii jumpa'n gu Adullam kua' yooxi' gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Rapaim.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii ka't jano' ba' gu kavɨk ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Pilisteos gu Bet-leem.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios jano' ba'; gio ba' chɨkka guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios i'i gu suudai' oidha' suudai' gu Bet-leem ki'ñgob.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam vaik guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm yooxi' gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu suudai' oidha' suudai' gu Bet-leem ki'ñgob guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam aichdhak gu Dabii; gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ i'i guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ja'aa gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'.

Jano' ba' cham jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam dhi'; gio ba' ka't tu' i'i gu ɨ'ɨr dhi' ja'tkam gu chio'ñ bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ i'i; mi' dhɨr dhi' jix duu mii' dhɨr ja'tkam vaik jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Abisai xibhɨk gu Joab ka't mo'o vaik guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ u'u kavɨk bhaan vaik naaka'n; gio ba' ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaik guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' vaik ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gook ka't gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gu' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam vaik dharka'.

Jano' ba' gu Benaiias gu mar gu Joiada gu mar gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Kabseel; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gook guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Moab; mi' dhɨr gio jix dhaav tu' naaka'n maavɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jabook.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Egipkio gu chio'ñ jixchamaam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ dhi'; gio ba' gu Egipkio guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ u'u kavɨk na ja'p guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gu' jix dhaav bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Egipkio u'u kavɨk gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨɨx u'u kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix duu dhi' gu Benaiias gu mar gu Joiada ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaik jix kavɨk.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ nɨidhat guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam vaik dharka'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix dhaas gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix kavɨk chugi'ñ; gio ba' gu Asael xibhɨk gu Joab gu Elkânan gu mar gu Dodo gu Bet-leem.
Jano' ba' gu Samot gu Arori gu elles gu Pelonita.
Jano' ba' gu Ira gu mar gu Akkes gu Tekoita gu Abieser gu Anatotita.
Jano' ba' gu Sibbekai gu usatita gu Ilai gu Aoita.
Jano' ba' gu Maarai gu Netopatita gu eled gu mar gu Baana gu Netopatita.
Jano' ba' gu Itai gu mar gu Ribai gu Gabaat gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu Benaiias gu Piratita.
Jano' ba' gu urai gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Gaas gu Abiel gu Arbatonita.
Jano' ba' gu Asmabet gu Baarumita gu Eliaba gu Saalbonita.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Asem gu Gisonita gu Jonataan gu mar gu Sajee gu ararita.
Jano' ba' gu Aiam gu mar gu Sakâr gu Ararita gu Elipal gu mar gu Ur.
Jano' ba' gu eper gu Mekêratita gu Aiia gu Pelonita.
Jano' ba' gu esro gu Karmelita gu Naari gu mar gu Esbai.
Jano' ba' gu Joel xibhɨk gu Nataan gu Mibar gu mar gu Agrai.
Jano' ba' gu Selek gu Ammonita gu Naarai gu Berotita kutun kavɨk gu Joab gu mar gu Sarbia.
Jano' ba' gu Ira gu Itreo gu Yared gu Itreo.
Jano' ba' gu Uriia gu eteo gu Sabad gu mar gu Ali.
Jano' ba' gu Adina gu mar gu Sisa gu Rubenita gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu Rubenitas bɨɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu anaan gu mar gu Maakâ gu Josapat gu Mitnita.
Jano' ba' gu Ussiias gu Astarotita gu Samma gu Jeiel gu ma'nkam gu otam gu Arorita.
Jano' ba' gu Jediael gu mar gu Simri gu Joa xibhɨk gu Tisaita.
Jano' ba' gu Eliel gu Maabii gu Jeribai gu Josabia gu ma'nkam gu Elnaam tu' gu Itma gu Moabita.
Jano' ba' gu Eliel gu Obed gu Jaasiel gu Mesobia.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam tɨɨtɨs gu Dabii gu Siklag kua' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kuiñcha gu Sauul gu mar gu Kis guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix kavɨk guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Jano' ba' mi'p gu ñi'ook u'u gat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu noobh jix duu gu jodai bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨɨx u'u gat; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu Sauul gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu Aieser mi' dhɨr gu Joas gu ma'nkam gu Semaa gu Gabaatita; gio ba' gu Jesiel gu Pelet gu ma'nkam gu Asmabet gu Beraka gu Jeuu gu Anatotita.
Jano' ba' gu Ismaiias gu Gabaonita jix kavɨk tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' gu Jeremiiyas gu Jaasiel gu Joanaan gu Josabad gu Gederatita.
Jano' ba' gu Elusai gu Jeremot gu Bealiias gu Semariias gu Sepatiias gu arupita.
Jano' ba' gu Elkana tu' gu Isiias gu Asareel gu Joeser gu Jasobam gu Koree.
Jano' ba' gu Joela gu Sebadiias gu ma'nkam gu Jeroam gu Gedor.

Jano' ba' gio gu Gad jiboi'ññor gu Dabii kua' gu kavɨk oidha' jix gaki guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix kavɨk gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham na ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu jiim bɨɨx kutun kavɨk guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix duu na ja'p chiiw gu kakkavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Eser maa'n gu Obadiias gook gu Eliab vaik.
Jano' ba' gu Mismana maakobh gu Jeremiiyas jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' gu Attai xijumai gu Eliel kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' gu Joanaan guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Elsabad guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jeremiiyas guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Makbani guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu ma'nkam gu Gad; gio ba' jix ali' ga'ra' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu chichio'ñ jix gɨ' mambhɨɨx gɨ'.

Na pai' dhuuk dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jordaan guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ maa'n na pai' dhuuk ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu jiim; gio ba' tu' jix duu guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tas buusñi guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam dhɨt gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu Judaa tɨɨtɨs gu Dabii gu kavɨk.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii jix buus bham; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨbiap tu' na ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ na ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu i'ii'ñ ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gu' tu' na ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu noobh cham tu' na cham jir bhai' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tattat guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Amasai gɨ'kora' ja'tkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' gu ñi'ook gu Dabii bɨndak gu ñi'ook gu mar gu Isaii; mi' dhɨr bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨndak bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; na gu' gio gu Jawatan Dios tu' u'ua'tɨdham; gio ba' gu Dabii guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix dhaas tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Na pai' dhuuk gio guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Dabii dhɨt gu Manasees na pai' dhuuk suudai' u'va bɨɨx gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan gu Sauul guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bham; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ɨɨbhidham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jawatan gu Sauul.
Na ba' bai'ñpu' gu Siklag guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Manasees gu Adnas gu Josabad gu Jediaiel gu Mikâel gu Josabad gu Eliuu gu Silletai chiñia' jix duu gu Manasees.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Dabii bhaan mii' dhɨr chu'p; na gu' bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Na gu' na gu' jano' ba' bɨx gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn u'ua'tɨdham gu Dabii bɨɨx ka'm tu jiim jix gɨ' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham na ja'p ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' dhi' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu ñi'ook mi'p guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bhɨɨ'ñdham tɨɨtɨs gu Dabii gu ebroon na ba' bhaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Sauul jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Judaa guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kutun kavɨk u'u kavɨk guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Simeoon jix kavɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu chichio'ñ na ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham kɨɨv mambhɨɨx gɨ' chamaam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii maakobh mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Joiada gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon bɨɨx vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' gu Sadok biapma' jix kavɨk guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gook gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu ja'tkam gu Sauul vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ'; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios mui'x ko'kmarak baasɨ'n gu vaak gu Sauul.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Epraim guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix kavɨk gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu vaak tattat.

Jano' ba' ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Dabii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Issakâr guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu ñi'ook pui'm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu ñi'ook oi'ñchu' bɨx gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu Sabuloon mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vaak ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Neptalii mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ kɨɨv mambhɨɨx gɨ' bɨɨx kutun kavɨk u'u kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Dan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' gu Aser guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga oo'm mambhɨɨx gɨ'.
Jano' ba' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu Rubenitas gu Gad ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees chamaam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' bɨɨx bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tɨɨtɨs bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ebroon na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Dabii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' bhaan bɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Israeel mi'p guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Dabii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora'.

Na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨɨx gu Dabii vaik gu tanoolh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios na gu' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam na ba'.

Jano' ba' gio guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx ka'm gu Issakâr gu Sabuloon gu Neptalii aichdhak gu takarui' buur jix ai guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu vaakax; na gu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu' gu vaakax kakneer guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na gu' gu Israeel ka't bhai' ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨɨx bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Israeel jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas bɨɨx jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx no'ch.

Na gu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios no'ch na gu' dɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Sauul cham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Ba' jix aa' bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ na gu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam xoi'kam bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu Dabii bɨx gu Israeel dɨr gu Sior gu Ejipto bɨɨx ka'm baakɨi gu amat na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Kîriat-jearim.

Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Dabii bɨɨx bɨx gu Israeel gu Baala gu Kîriat-jearim gu Judaa na ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Jano' ba' bhɨɨk kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu Abinadab guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix vɨɨk; gio ba' gu Ussa xibhɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Dabii bɨx gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' na jix kavɨk bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk.
Na gu' na ja'p guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ka't gu Kidoon gu Ussa guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu novɨ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' na ba' jix xoi'kam na gu' gu vaakax guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Na gu' i'iich gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan gu Ussa tu' naaka'n na gu' ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu novɨ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'; gio ba' jix koi vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Na gu' gu Dabii guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix duu na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Ussa; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jup tɨɨt mii' dhɨr pai' gu Peeres-ussa bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu vaak kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Dabii kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu vaak kiicham gu Dabii guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu vaak gu Obed-edom gu Geteo.

Jano' ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios juruuñ gu vaak gu Obed-edom gu vaak vaik masaa'n; gio ba' jix bhai' aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu Obed-edom guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x ga'ra'.
Jano' ba' gu iram gu gɨ'kora' gu Tiro bhañ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Dabii gu u'u gɨ' u'u kavɨk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu jiim guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vaak.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii jix bhɨɨ gio gu u'vɨ gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix mar gu Dabii gu ma'nkam tu' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu Samua gu Sobab gu Nataan gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' gu Ibar gu Elisua gu Elipelet.
Jano' ba' gu Noga gu Nepeg gu Japiias.
Jano' ba' gu Elisama gu Beel-iada gu Elipelet.

Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Pilisteos gu Dabii ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ Xoi'kam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' bhaan bɨx gu Israeel guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨx gu Pilisteos tu jiim gu Dabii; gio ba' na ja'p gu Dabii jix kai jix buus bhaan.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Pilisteos jix duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Rapaim.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bhaan gu Pilisteos kapbhai' gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu jiim tu' kapbhai' gu noobh.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Baal-perasim naaka'n gu Dabii; gio ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu suudai'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr pai' gu Baal-perasim.
Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios gu Dabii guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu tai.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Pilisteos tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jaja' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga vupui bhaan tu' jix duu yooxi' gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Dabii na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix tu' yooxi' gu Pilisteos dɨr gu Gabaoon bɨɨx ka'm gu Geser.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Dabii ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' jix dhaas gu Jawatan Dios choo'n gu Dabii bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu vaak na ba' kiicham gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ pai' na ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ vaak zel.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii; gio ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Lebitas; na gu' tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu Dabii bɨx gu Israeel gu Jerusalem na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios pai' ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gio gu Dabii gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu Lebitas.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koat gu Uriel gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam chamaam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Merari gu Asaiias gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon gu Joel gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam chamaam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Elisapaan gu Semeiias gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu ebroon gu Eliel gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ussiel gu Aminadab gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam chamaam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Dabii gu Sadok gu Abiatar jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas gu Uriel gu Asaiias gu Joel gu Semeiias gu Eliel gu Aminadab.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ñi'ook tattat tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Lebitas guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel pai' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm cham tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios no'ch guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam na gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bhaan jir bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Lebitas aichdhak kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn na ja'p ka't jix duu gu Moisees jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Dabii gu ñi'ook gu Lebitas guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bhai' ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Lebitas guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu emaan gu mar gu Joel; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu Asap gu mar gu Berekîas; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Merari gu ja'tkam gu Etaan gu mar gu Kusaiias.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gook guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Sakâriias gu Ben gu Jaasiel gu Semiramot gu Jeiel gu Unni gu Eliab gu Benaiias gu Maasiias gu Matitiias gu Elipeleu gu Mikniias gu Obed-edom gu Jeiel tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu emaan gu Asap gu Etaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu mar bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Sakâriias gu Jaasiel gu Semiramot gu Jeiel gu Unni gu Eliab gu Maasiias gu Benaiias bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bhaan gu Alamot.
Jano' ba' gu Matitiias gu Elipeleu gu Mikniias gu Obed-edom gu Jeiel gu Asasiias alabaa'n bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam daam.
Jano' ba' gu Kênaniias gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu Lebitas ka't na ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ na gu' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Jano' ba' gu Berekîas gu Elkana guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu jiim kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu Sebaniias gu Josapat gu Natanael gu Amasai gu Sakâriias gu Benaiias gu Elieser jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Obed-edom gu Jeiias guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gio tu jiim kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu Dabii daraa gu Israeel guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix duu jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu Obed-edom bɨɨx bhai' ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios gu Lebitas guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan kɨɨv guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ kɨɨv gu chuukug.
