Jano' ba' gu Asap maa'n gook mi' dhɨr gu Sakâriias gu Jeiel gu Semiramot gu Jeiel gu Matitiias gu Eliab gu Benaiias gu Obed-edom gu Jeiel bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gu' gu Asap guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' gu Benaiias gio gu Jaasiel jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix maa gu Dabii gɨ'kora' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ gu Asap gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu tɨɨgɨ' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ja'tkam buimɨi.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gio ba' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kɨɨ'p.
Jano' ba' gu Gloriaos jix bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios gu kavɨk; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu vupui guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn chɨ'ñchoka' kɨɨ'p tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu chin.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu kai' gu Israeel tu duukam gu ma'nkam gu Jakob guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn chɨ'ñchoka' ñi'ook na jix bhaan guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ñi'ook jix aa'ñdhix mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu ma'nkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jakob guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ñi'ook kavɨk gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ñi'ook na jix bhaan guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Jano' ba' bham; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu oidha' gu Kanaan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jɨɨ'ñdhidha' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ soo'mchulhdhak guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; gio ba' va'k guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm xoi'kam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios cham bhai' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu oidha' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu tanoolh tulhiiñdha'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp gɇ'kamtu'nda' bɨx gu ja'tkam kɨɨ'p.

Gu' gu' tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gio ba' atooxkor ka't gu ñi'ook na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Ba' jix aa' jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' bɨx dhi' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Nataan gu Dabii.

Ba' jix aa' chɨbiapui gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii juruuñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios chɨkka guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu vaak guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨɨx ka'm dhi' pai'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu ñi'ook gu vaak tu duukam na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ na ja'p gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jɨ'xdha' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Dabii guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu' na ba' tas na jix gɨ' tu duukam gu' tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu duukam.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm xoi'kam tu duukam bhaan gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨx dhi' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios cham cham tu'x jai'ch nɨidhim tu' cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ naak bɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ maatɨt.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ja'tkam cham tu'x jai'ch gu oidha' na ja'p gu ja'tkam gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios jum duu guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ja'tkam na ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨɨx guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios kɨɨ'p guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ chɨbɨɨp vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Ejipto.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ja'tkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tɨbiap guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu duukam gu vaak ka't gu ñi'ook na ba' bɨɨx tas gu vupui na ja'p.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu tɨɨgɨ' na ba' bɨɨx tas guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr ka't gu vaak tu duukam gu Dabii gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tu'.

Na gu' na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios naak tu duukam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' gaagam tu duukam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook tu duukam dhi' xoi'kam.

Jano' ba' jano' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu vaak tu duukam na ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ vupui bhaan tu'; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' tu'x ka't gu Dabii naaka'n gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Gat guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu novɨ gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' gio naaka'n gu Moab; gio ba' gu Moabitas jix bɨɨx duu tu duukam gu Dabii guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' gu Asimismo naaka'n gu Dabii gu Adareser gu gɨ'kora' gu Soba gu amat jiimchu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Euprates.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Dabii mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam kɨɨv mambhɨɨx gɨ' kavaayo guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ tɨɨt; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Dabii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.
Jano' ba' bai'ñpu' gu Siros gu Damasko u'ua'tɨdham gu Adareser gu gɨ'kora' gu Soba gu Dabii naaka'n gu Siros guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu Dabii guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Siria gu Damasko gu Siros jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu duukam gu Dabii guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Dabii pai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gio gu Dabii kutun kavɨk jix uam jodai guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu duukam gu Adareser guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Tibat gu Kûn jɨ'dɨlh gu Adareser jix bhɨɨ gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix jai' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Salomoon gu gɨ' suudai' jix vɨgɨ jodai guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix vɨgɨ jodai.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Tou gu gɨ'kora' gu amat gu Dabii ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Adareser gu gɨ'kora' gu Soba.

Jano' ba' bhañ gu Adoram gu mar gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii tulhiiñdha' jix bhai' aa' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨɨx gu Adareser tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; na gu' gu Tou ga'ra' bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx gu Adareser; mi' dhɨr bhañ gio bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix uam jodai jix toja jodai guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx jix toja jodai jix uam jodai ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ja'tkam gu Edom gu Moab gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu Pilisteos gu Amalek.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ dhi' gu Abisai gu mar gu Sarbia naaka'n guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Sal guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu Idumeos.

Jano' ba' jix dhaas guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Edom bɨx gu Idumeos jix bɨɨx duu tu duukam gu Dabii; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Dabii pai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' jix gɨ'kora' gu Dabii bhaan bɨx gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨx bhai' bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Joab gu mar gu Sarbia ka't guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' gu Josapat gu mar gu Ailud guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Sadok gu mar gu Akîtob gu Abimelek gu mar gu Abiatar guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' gu Sausa guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.
Jano' ba' gu Benaiias gu mar gu Joiada ka't bhaan gu Kereteos gu Peleteos; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Dabii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm chiñia' mia'n gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' tu'x ka't jix koi gu Naas gu gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu mar.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bɨɨx gu anaan gu mar gu Naas na gu' gio gu taat jix duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch; mi' dhɨr gu Dabii bhañ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios koi'm gu taat; gu' jix duu tu duukam gu Dabii gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu anaan na ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ duu.

Jano' ba' chiñia' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gui'p gu anaan; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ nɨidhat gu Dabii gu taat tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ nuukdaidha' cham jupaabkamu'n va'k tu duukam tu' na ba' kutun kavɨk tu' tu jiim guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu anaan jix bhɨɨ tu duukam gu Dabii guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jajannulhi'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Na gu' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Dabii mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chio'ñ bhañ jix duu na gu' mi'p guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' jix duu guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu Jerikoo bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Dabii gu anaan gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon mɨjɨ mambhɨɨx gɨ' cha'tmam jix toja jodai na ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam kavaayo gu Siria guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Siria gu Maakâ gu Soba.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gook mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora' gu Maakâ gu ja'tkam tɨɨtɨs guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi' vupui bhaan gu Medeba; gio ba' jum daa'ñ gio gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon jɨ'dɨlh tɨɨtɨs bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Dabii bhañ gu Joab bɨɨx bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon moor guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ba'k kiicham; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨbiap mi'p guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm yooxi'.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Joab gu vupui guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ ka't bhaan vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu ñi'ook ka't gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bhaan gu Siros.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu ja'tkam gu novɨ gu Abisai xibhɨk guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan gu Ammonitas.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gu Siros ua'tulhi'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix kavɨk tu' u'ua'tɨda'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Ammonitas ua'tulhi'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix kavɨk tu' dodhia'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm chulhiiñdha' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jɨ'dɨlh chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios xoi'kam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Joab gu ja'tkam ga'ra' baidhak na ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu Siros; gu' jiboi'ññor vupui bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon ñɨi'ñ gu Siros guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jiboi'ññor gio vupui bhaan gu Abisai xibhɨk baap kiicham; gio ba' jano' ba' gu Joab guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Siros guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vupui bhaan gu Israeel mɨjɨ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ aichdhak gu Siros mi'p baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't gu Sopak guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Adareser.

Jano' ba' ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu Dabii jum daa'ñ bɨx gu Israeel bhɨi gu Jordaan suudai' u'va guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhaan ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' na ja'p gu Dabii ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx gu Siros.

Gu' gu' gu Siro guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Dabii gu Siros kɨɨv mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam oo'm mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ tɨɨt; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Sopak guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Siros gu Adareser guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vupui bhaan gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu Dabii jix bɨɨx duu tu duukam; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Siro guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios oidha' tas guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Joab jix buusñi tu' na jix kavɨk ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon suudai' u'va guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Rabba; gu' gu Dabii ka't gu Jerusalem; mi' dhɨr gu Joab guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Rabba guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Dabii kuruun gu gɨ'kora' tu jiim mo'o gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gɨ' maa'nkar jodai jix uam jodai ka't gu jodai a'bhar; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhaan mo'o gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn dhi' jix buusñi kiicham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' jix buusñi gio gu ja'tkam ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨɨx guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix kavɨk jodai guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' jix duu gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Dabii bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' ka't jix búup bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Geser bɨɨx gu Pilisteos; gio ba' tu' naaka'n gu Sibbekai gu usatita gu Sippai gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; mi' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx gu Pilisteos; gio ba' tu' naaka'n gu Elanaan gu mar gu Jair gu Lami xibhɨk gu Goliat gu Geteo guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat u'u kavɨk ka't na ja'p guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Gat pai' ka't gu chio'ñ jix gɨ' dhi' ga'ra' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tɨɨt gu noobh bɨx maakob; gio ba' gio ka't gu mar gu Rapa.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Israeel gu' naaka'n gu Jonataan gu mar gu Sima xibhɨk gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Rapa gu Gat ia'rɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ gu Dabii tu duukam.
Gu' gu' gu Satanaas jix búup bhaan gu Israeel tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Dabii guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Joab chiñia' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Israeel dɨr gu Beer-seba bɨɨx ka'm gu Dan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jɨɨ'ñdhidha' na ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Ba' jix aa' gu Joab; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim mui'kim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam cham bɨx dhi' ja'tkam tu duukam gu Jawatan na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Jawatan dhi' ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Israeel.

Gu' gu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Joab; gio ba' jix buus guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Joab ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jerusalem jix maa guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu ja'tkam gu Dabii.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu Israeel guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu kuchii guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ mui'kim guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim mambhɨɨx gɨ'; gio ba' gu Judaa guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu kuchii.
Na gu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' ja'tkam cham jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Lebitas tu' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin na gu' gu Joab guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ dhi' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios tu' naaka'n gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' uañi'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam dhi'; na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tu' na cham jir bhai' tu duukam na gu' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Gad guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Dabii bham.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Dabii guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr vaik tu'x tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨndak.
Ba' jix aa' bai'ñpu' gu Gad gu Dabii; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa vaik guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhiogi'; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vaik masaa'n guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu kuchii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vaik gu tanoolh gu kuchii gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu oidha' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨx gu oidha' gu Israeel; jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu ñi'ook tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu Gad; gio ba' dhi' jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; mi' dhɨr soi'ñ tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam mumua'da' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tu' gu noobh gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Israeel ia'rɨ gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Jawatan Dios nobii'ñ gu Jerusalem na ba' cham tu' duu; gu' kua' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam mii' dhɨr cham bhai'.

Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu novɨ; jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't ju'ñdharan ka't gu Ornaan gu Jebuseo.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Dabii gu vupui jix ñi' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' ua'tulhdhidha' gu kuchii guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bhaan gu Jerusalem; gio ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii daraa guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' jix duu guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam cham bhai'; gu' dhi' kakneer guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam ka't jano' gu novɨ bhaan tu' bhaan gu vaak gu taat cham ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Gad tu ñi'ook gu Dabii guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Ornaan gu Jebuseo.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii jix tɨ'ɨ jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Gad ka't tu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gɨɨsɨk gu Ornaan jix ñi' nobii'ñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam maakobh gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨɨx mi'p; mi' dhɨr gu Ornaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tiriik.
Jano' ba' bai'ñpu' gu Dabii gu Ornaan tu jiim guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix ñi' gu Dabii; gio ba' gamai' ka't o'lhia'n gu oidha' gu Dabii.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu Ornaan; gio ba' gu Dame dhi' pai' ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm u'uuk na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu Ornaan jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ na ba' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' xoi'kam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu vaakax guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ba' gu u'u tiriik na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨx.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii gu Ornaan; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jir bhai' u'uuk; na gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan cham tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Dabii gu Ornaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm pai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix uam jodai guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Dabii jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios makgɨrxi maa'nkar tai bhaan makgɨrxi'ñdha' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tai gu tɨkɨr jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios nobii'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu kuchii guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios ka't naak ka't gu Ornaan gu Jebuseo maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan.

Jano' ba' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam oidha' jix gaki jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan mi'p jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Gabaoon; na gu' gu' gu Dabii cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios na gu' ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ kuiñcha gu kuchii nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' dhi' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios dhi' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan na ba' gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix aa'ñdhix gu Dabii guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix duu mi'p gu oidha' gu Israeel nɨi'ñchudat tɨ'ya' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu jodai na ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Dabii jix jai' jix kavɨk jodai na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim kiki'ñgob na ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' jix jai' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu u'u gɨ' u'u kavɨk cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.
Na gu' na gu' gu Sidonios gu Tirios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Dabii gu u'u gɨ' u'u kavɨk guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' gu Salomoon gu mar guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu vaak tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' nɨidhat guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; mi' dhɨr jano' tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨɨpɨ'm; jano' ba' tu jiim gu Dabii va'k koi'm jix gɨ' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt jano' ba' gu Dabii gu Salomoon gu mar jix aa'ñdhix guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Salomoon; gio ba' gu mar guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios.

Gu' gu' suudai' u'va tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' tu' vaak na jix bhaan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ɨ'ɨr guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; na gu' cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' na gu' vaak na jix bhaan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ɨ'ɨr gu oidha' vupui bhaan tu'.

Na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu mar tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ka't gu chio'ñ jɨɨpi'ñka' na gu' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't gu Salomoon; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhai'x i'ii'ñ jɨɨpi'ñka' bhaan gu Israeel gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu mar tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu taat; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam atooxkor oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' jano' gu mar guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam ka't bɨndak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook tu'.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu' jix maa gu ñi'ook na ba' gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' ka' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu' tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam ñi'ook kavɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees na ba' gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr cham jum i'obh tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim mambhɨɨx gɨ' cha'tmam jix uam jodai guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jix duu cha'tmam jix toja jodai; na gu' cham juraa'n guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' jix kavɨk jodai na gu' jix jai'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu u'u gu jodai tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.
Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨndak mui'x guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tɨ'ya' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu jiim bɨx gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨx tu duukam.
Jano' ba' jix uam jodai jix toja jodai guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix kavɨk jodai cham cham tu'x jai'ch jɨɨ'ñdhidha'; gio ba' bamii' tu duukam; na gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨndak.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix aa'ñdhix gu Dabii bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam u'ua'tɨdham gu Salomoon gu mar bham.

Na gu' cham bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios na gu' tu' dhagia' gu novɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jano' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios xidhuu gu Jawatan Dios na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jɨɨgi'ñdham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Dabii tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu tanoolh gu Salomoon gu mar gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Lebitas guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jiix; gio ba' ka't jɨɨ'ñdhidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ɨɨbhidham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm maa'n guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ'.

Jano' ba' suulhgia' maakob mambhɨɨx gɨ' na ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn mambhɨɨx gɨ'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn maakobh mambhɨɨx gɨ' tu jiim; gio ba' maakobh mambhɨɨx gɨ' na ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Dabii bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhai' ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Dabii guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios jurtu'nka' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii gu Gersoon gu Koat gu Merari.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon; gio ba' gu Ladaan gu Simi.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ladaan vaik; gio ba' gu Jeiel maa'n mi' dhɨr gu Setam gu Joel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Simi vaik; gio ba' gu Selomit gu asiel gu Araan; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu chiñia' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Ladaan.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Simi; gio ba' gu Jaat gu Sinat gu Jeus gu Beriias; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam maakobh jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Simi.
Jano' ba' gu Jaat ka't maa'n gu Sinat gook; gu' gu Jeus gu Beriias cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koat; gio ba' gu Amram gu Isar gu ebroon gu Ussiel maakobh.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Amram; gio ba' gu Aaroon gu Moisees; mi' dhɨr gu Aaroon ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu'x gu ma'nkam na ba' bɨɨx tas na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu tɨɨgɨ' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Moisees gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bopxi'ñ gu Lebii.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Moisees jix bɨɨx duu gu Gersoon gu Elieser.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Gersoon ka't gu Sebuel maa'n.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Elieser ka't gu Reabiia maa'n; gio ba' gu Elieser cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ma'nkam; gu' gu ma'nkam gu Reabiia jix bɨɨx duu mui'x.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Isar ka't gu Selomit maa'n.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu ebroon; gio ba' gu Jeriia maa'n gu Amariias gook gu Jaasiel vaik gu Jekamaan maakobh.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ussiel; gio ba' gu Mikâ maa'n tu' gu Isiia gook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Merari; gio ba' gu Maali gu Musi; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Maali; jano' ba' gu Eleasar gu Kis.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Eleasar cham gu ma'nkam gu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Kis gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Musi; gio ba' gu Maali gu Eder gu Jerimot vaik.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Lebii guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tattat jix duu guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ɨɨbhidham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu duukam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jiix.
Ba' jix aa' na gu' gu Dabii; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jerusalem na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gio gu Lebitas cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.
Na ba' jurtu'nka' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu Dabii ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam gu Lebii guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jiix.

Jano' ba' mi'p guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu novɨ gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon na ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix duu guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu duukam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam na ba' gu takarui' tɨkiix na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ na ba' gu maa'nkar na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham jabka' na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam na ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' na ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu xibh bɨx gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu xumai.

Jano' ba' na ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨx maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam duñiaꞌ ko'kmarak guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix nukadham vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut jix nukadham xidhuu guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gio gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon chooto'n guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon; mi' dhɨr gu Nadab gu Abiuu gu Eleasar tu' gu Itamar.
Gu' gu' gu Nadab gu Abiuu jix koko' va'k gu taat cham chooto'n gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu Eleasar tu' gu Itamar chooto'n jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Sadok gu ma'nkam gu Eleasar gu Aimelek gu ma'nkam gu Itamar guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Eleasar jix bɨɨx duu bakia' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ mui'x guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Itamar; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Eleasar ka't guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam ɨɨbhidham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Itamar guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tattat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨɨx; na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Eleasar gu ma'nkam gu Itamar ka't chiñia' xidhuu chiñia' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Semeiias guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu mar gu Natanael gu Lebitas ua'na vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' chiñia' vupui bhaan gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Aimelek gu mar gu Abiatar chiñia' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ja'tkam vaak gu Eleasar gu Itamar.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix buus guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Joiarib gookim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jedaiia.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu arim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Seorim.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Malkîas guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Miamim.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Kos guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Abiiyas.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jesua guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Sekâniia.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Eliasib guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jakim.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Uppa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Isebeab.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Bilga guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Immer.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu esir guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Apses.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Petaiia guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu esekiel.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jakim guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu amul.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Delaiia guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Maasiia.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na ba' ba'k gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jurtu'nka' jir bɨx bhai' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Aaroon gu taat ka't jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' gu Subael gu ma'nkam gu Amram; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Subael gu Jeediias.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Reabiia gu Isias gɨ'kora' ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Isareos gu Selemot; gio ba' tu' gu mar gu Selemot gu Jat.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu ebroon; gio ba' gu Jeria maa'n gook gu Amariias vaik gu Jaasiel maakobh gu Jekamaan.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Ussiel gu Mikâ; gio ba' tu' gu mar gu Mikâ gu Samir.
Jano' ba' xibhɨk gu Mikâ gu Isiia; gio ba' tu' gu mar gu Isiia gu Sakâriias.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Merari; gio ba' gu Maali gu Musi; mi' dhɨr gu mar gu Jaasia gu Benno.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Merari guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jaasia; gio ba' gu Benno gu Soam gu Sakûr tu' gu Ibri.
Jano' ba' gu Maali gu Eleasar cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Kis gu Jerameel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Musi; gio ba' gu Maeli gu Eder gu Jerimot; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Lebitas jurtu'nka' gu vaak guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gio guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mamai'chɨk na ja'p gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii gu Sadok gu Aimelek chiñia' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas; gio ba' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam tattat guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix ali' gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu Asimismo gu Dabii chiñia' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu ma'nkam gu Asap gu emaan gu Jedutuun guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' ka't gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ na ba' tu duukam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Asap; gio ba' gu Sakûr gu Josee gu Metaniias gu Asareela gu ma'nkam gu Asap guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Asap guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu Jedutuun; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jedutuun gu Gedaliias gu Sesi gu Jesaiias gu asabiias gu Matitiias gu Simi; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu novɨ gu taat gu Jedutuun guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu emaan; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu emaan gu Bukkia gu Mataniia gu Ussiel gu Sebuel gu Jerimot gu ananiias gu anani gu Eliata gu Gidalti gu Romamti-eser gu Josbekasa gu Malloti gu Otir gu Maasiot.

Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu emaan guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gio ba' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios gu emaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu ma'nkam vaik ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.

Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam mi'p guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu taat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Asap gu Jedutuun gu emaan.

Jano' ba' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' bɨɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ka't guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mamai'chɨk na ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn baakɨk jix ali' bɨɨx jix gɨ' tɨkkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix buus guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Asap gu Josee; gio ba' gookim gu Gedaliias bɨɨx gu ja'tkam tu' gu ma'nkam jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Sakûr bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Isri bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Netaniias bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Bukkia bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Jesarela bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jesaiias bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Mataniias bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Simi bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Asareel bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu asabiias bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Subael bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Matitiias bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jerimot bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ananiias bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Josbekasa bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu anani bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Malloti bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Eliata bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Otir bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Giddalti bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Maasiot bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Romamti-eser bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu jiim; gio ba' gu Koraitas; mi' dhɨr gu Meselemia gu mar gu Koree gu ma'nkam gu Asap.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Meselemia; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat maa'nkam mar gu Jediael gook gu Sebadiias vaik gu Jatnael maakobh.
Jano' ba' gu Elam jixchamaam gu Joanam xijumai gu Elioenai kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Obed-edom; gio ba' gu Semeiias maa'nkam mar gu Josabad gook gu Joab vaik maakobh gu Sakâr jixchamaam gu Natanael.
Jano' ba' xijumai gu Anmiel kɨɨv gu Issakâr guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Peulletai; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Obed-edom.

Jano' ba' gio gu Semeiias gu mar guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ma'nkam jix bɨɨx duu gu Jawatan bhaan gu vaak tattat; na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Semeiias; gio ba' gu Otni gu Rapael gu Obed gu Elsabad gu ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Eliuu gu Samakîas.

Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Obed-edom; gio ba' bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix kavɨk na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gook gu Obed-edom.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Meselemia gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu osa gu ma'nkam gu Merari; gio ba' gu Simri gɨ'kora' ja'tkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham ka't maa'nkam mar gu' gu taat jix dhaas na ba' jum duu mo'o; mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' gook gu ilkiias vaik gu Tebeliias maakobh gu Sakâriias; gio ba' bɨx gu ma'nkam gu osa gu ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Jano' ba' jix duu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu jiim guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx gu ja'tkam na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mamai'chɨk jix ali' bɨɨx jix gɨ' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak tattat na ba' ki'ñgob.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tas buusñi gu Selemiia; gio ba' gu Sakâriias gu mar guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam mamai'chɨk; mi' dhɨr jix buus guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Obed-edom saagi'ñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam gu vaak guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Suppim gu osa tas gei'ñ bɨɨx ki'ñgob gu Sallekêt gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.
Jano' ba' tas buusñi guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Lebitas guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn maakobh gu tanoolh; gio ba' saagi'ñ maakobh gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr gu vaak guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gook.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tas gei'ñ maakobh gu bhóogɨt gook guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu jiim gu ma'nkam gu Koraitas gu ma'nkam gu Merari.
Jano' ba' gu Lebitas gu Akîas ga'ra' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu'x guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam gu Ladaan gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon; gio ba' gu Ladaan chiñia' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Ladaan jix bɨɨx duu gu Gersoon gu Jeieli.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jeieli gu Setaan gu Joel xibhɨk chooto'n guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Amramitas gu Isaritas gu ebronitas gu Ussielitas.
Jano' ba' gu Sebuel gu mar gu Gersoon gu mar gu Moisees ka't gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam xibhɨk gu Elieser gu mar guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ka't gu Reabiia gu mar guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Isaiiyas gu mar guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Joram gu mar guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Sikri ka't gu mar gu Selomit.

Jano' ba' dhi' gu Selomit gu ja'tkam ko'kmarak guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨx guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii chiñia' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba' tu jiim gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Samueel guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Sauul gu mar gu Kis gu Abner gu mar gu Ner gu Joab gu mar gu Sarbia; gio ba' bɨx no'x guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu novɨ gu Selomit gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Isaritas gu Kenaniia gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhaan gu Israeel buimɨi mai'.

Jano' ba' gu ebronitas gu asabiias gu ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Israeel baasɨ'n gu Jordaan tas gei'ñ bɨx tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu ebronitas gu Jeriias ka't gɨ'kora' ja'tkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ebronitas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' oidha' tas oo'm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Dabii guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix kavɨk guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jaser gu Galaad.

Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gook mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam ɨɨbhidham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bhaan gu Rubenitas gu Gaditas bhaan ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bhaan jɨɨ'ñdhidha' maachim chiñia' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bopxi'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu gɨ'kora' bɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨx masaa'n oidha' tas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ maakobh mambhɨɨx gɨ'.

Jano' ba' bhaan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam maa'n guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't gu Jasobam gu mar gu Sabdiel; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ maakobh mambhɨɨx gɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Pares ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam maa'n guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' bhaan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gook guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't gu Dodai gu Aoita; gio ba' gu Miklot ka't jix gɨ' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gio ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ maakobh mambhɨɨx gɨ'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' vaik guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't gu Benaiias gu mar gu Joiada guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ maakobh mambhɨɨx gɨ'.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu Benaiias ka't jix kavɨk tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ka't gu Amisabad gu mar.

Jano' ba' maakobh guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios na ba' maakobh guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't gu Asael xibhɨk gu Joab mi' dhɨr gu Sebadiias gu mar; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ maakobh mambhɨɨx gɨ'.

Jano' ba' jixchamaam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios na ba' jixchamaam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't gu Sambut gu Isrita; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ maakobh mambhɨɨx gɨ'.
Jano' ba' xijumai na ba' xijumai guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't gu ira gu mar gu Ikkes gu Tekoa; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ maakobh mambhɨɨx gɨ'.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv na ba' kɨɨv guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't gu elles gu Pelonita gu ma'nkam gu Epraim; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ maakobh mambhɨɨx gɨ'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't gu Sibbekai gu usatita gu Sarai; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ maakobh mambhɨɨx gɨ'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn na ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't gu Abieser gu Anatotita gu Benjamitas; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ maakobh mambhɨɨx gɨ'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga na ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't gu Maarai gu Netopatita gu Sarai; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ maakobh mambhɨɨx gɨ'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't gu Benaiias gu Piratonita gu ma'nkam gu Epraim; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ maakobh mambhɨɨx gɨ'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't gu eldai gu Netopatita gu Otniel; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ maakobh mambhɨɨx gɨ'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhaan bopxi'ñ gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Rubenitas ka't gu Elieser gu mar gu Sikri; mi' dhɨr gu Simeonitas gu Sepatiias gu mar gu Maakâ.
Jano' ba' gu Lebitas gu asabiias gu mar gu Kamuel; gio ba' gu Aaronitas gu Sadok.
Jano' ba' gu Judaa gu Eliuu maa'n gu ja'tkam gu Dabii; gio ba' gu Issakâr gu Omri gu mar gu Mikâel.
Jano' ba' gu Sabuloon gu Ismaiias gu mar gu Abdiias; gio ba' gu Neptalii gu Jerimot gu mar gu Asriel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Epraim gu Oseas gu mar gu Asasiia; gio ba' ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu Joel gu mar gu Pedaiia.
Jano' ba' ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu Galaad gu Iddo gu mar gu Sakâriias; gio ba' gu Benjamiin gu Jaakiel gu mar gu Abner.
Jano' ba' gu Dan gu Asarael gu mar gu Jeroam; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bopxi'ñ gu Israeel.

Na gu' cham jix bhɨɨ gu Dabii jɨɨ'ñdhidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Israeel na ja'p gu si'avag gu tɨkɨr.

Jano' ba' gu Joab gu mar gu Sarbia ka't kua'da' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu' cham jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' suudai' u'va guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' cham ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii.

Jano' ba' gu Asmabet gu mar gu Adiel ga'ra' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim vaak ja'tkam jɨ'dɨlh taañpu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Jonataan gu mar gu Ussiias.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Esri gu mar gu Kêlud.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Simi gu Ramatita; gio ba' gu i'bhɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Sabdiias gu Sipmita.
Jano' ba' tu jiim tu' iigɨx ka't vaak ja'tkam gu Baal-anan gu Gederita; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ bɨ'ñdhatu' gu Joas.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Saroon gu Sitrai gu Saronita; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam mi'p guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Sapat gu mar gu Adlai.
Jano' ba' jix ai gu Obil gu Ismaelita; gio ba' buur gu Jediias gu Meronotita.
Jano' ba' kakneer gu Jasis gu Agareno; gio ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii.

Jano' ba' gu Jonataan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Dabii ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; gio ba' gu Jeiel gu mar gu akmoni ka't bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gio gu Akitopel ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu usai gu Arakîta guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu Akitopel ka't gu Joiada gu mar gu Benaiias gu Abiatar; gio ba' gu Joab ka't guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu Dabii gu Jerusalem bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel chiñia' bopxi'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu gɨ'kora' bopxi'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨx guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu maa'nkar gu gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨx gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk.

Ba' jix aa' kɨkbo gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tɨɨt; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr tu' ga'ra' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak na ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' dhaibu' tɨɨt chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' ka't tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨx na ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ'; na gu' jix duu gu chio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham vaak na jix bhaan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ɨ'ɨr.

Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨx gu vaak gu taat na ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jum duu gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel; na gu' gu Judaa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu vaak gu Judaa ja'tkam vaak gu taat; mi' dhɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu taat guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu' na ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' bhaan bɨx gu Israeel.

Na gu' bɨx gu ma'nkam na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa mui'x gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu mar gu Salomoon na ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ atooxkor oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Salomoon gu mar guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; na gu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu mar tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu taat.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' na ba' bɨɨx tas tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jir bhai' na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' jano' vupui bhaan gu vupui bɨx gu Israeel guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios maatɨt chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨx ñi'ook kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios na ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jix bhai' gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu maa'nkar gu ma'nkam mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' tu' gu Salomoon gu mar guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios gu taat guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios kutun kavɨk guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨx guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; mi' dhɨr tu' tu jiim bakia'; gu' tu' jix duu tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ba' bɨɨx tas.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jano' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu vaak na ba' xidhuu; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu vupui.

Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix maa gu Salomoon gu mar guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vaak guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu jiim gu vaak guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x ga'ra' aagak na ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu'x guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' gio na ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas na ba' bɨx tu duukam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix maa jix uam jodai guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ba' jix uam jodai na ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gio ba' jix toja jodai guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Jano' ba' jix uam jodai guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ba' daa'nkar tai na jix tas jix uam jodai na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix uam jodai na ba' mɨichdhai guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; mi' dhɨr na ba' daa'nkar tai na jix tas jix toja jodai guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ba' mɨichdhai guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn mɨichdhai.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix maa jix uam jodai guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tɨkiix na ba' meesa; gio ba' jix toja jodai na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix toja jodai.

Jano' ba' gio jix uam jodai na jix bhai' na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix uam jodai na ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix toja jodai guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix uam jodai na jix bhai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam na ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jix uam jodai bɨɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' tu'x gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ buimɨi guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Dabii gu Salomoon gu mar; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam; na gu' cham jum i'obh tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨndak; jano' ba' cham tu' kiicha' tu' jix duu bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook bɨx tu duukam na ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas na ba' bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨndak bɨx tu duukam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ba' no'x na jax chu'm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; mi' dhɨr chiñia' bɨx gu ja'tkam na ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii bɨx bɨx ja'tkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Salomoon gu mar tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu duukam jix gɨ'; na gu' gu vaak cham na ba' gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' na jix kavɨk guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jix uam jodai na ba' tu'x jix uam jodai jix toja jodai na ba' tu'x jix toja jodai guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix kavɨk jodai na ba' jix kavɨk jodai gu u'u na ba' gu u'u gu jodai guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu jodai a'bhar gu jodai guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu jodai guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu jodai a'bhar gu jodai guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ dhi' na gu' no'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam chumñigam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix uam jodai jix toja jodai guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ba' gu vaak xidhuu jix maa na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' maachim vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' cha'tmam jix uam jodai gu Opir kɨɨv mambhɨɨx gɨ' cha'tmam jix toja jodai guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu vaak.

Jano' ba' jix uam jodai na ba' tu'x jix uam jodai jix toja jodai na ba' tu'x jix toja jodai na ba' bɨx tu duukam gu noobh guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' chɨkka guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' chiñia' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ chiñia' bopxi'ñ gu Israeel bopxi'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios aagak.

Jano' ba' jix maa na ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jixchamaam mambhɨɨx gɨ' cha'tmam jix uam jodai mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' cha'tmam jix toja jodai guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios mambhɨɨx gɨ' cha'tmam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jixchamaam mambhɨɨx gɨ' cha'tmam jix kavɨk jodai.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu jodai a'bhar jix maa na ba' chumñigam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ gu Jeiel gu Gersonita.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios aagak; na gu' bɨɨx guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix jai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii jix bhai' aa' gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel chulhiiñdha' gu taat maa'n guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gɇ'kamtu'nda' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' tu jiim bhaan bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mo'o.
Jano' ba' namkɨm gɇ'kamtu'nda' vupui bhaan tu' aapi' bɨx; gio ba' gu novɨ bɨxchu'x gu kavɨk gu novɨ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu kavɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x.
Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' no'ch tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tas na jix gɨ' gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Na gu' na gu' chɨkka guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' chɨkka gu ja'tkam na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat aagak tu'x tuutu'm na gu' bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dho'ñchidhak gu novɨ tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Na gu' na gu' no'ch jix duu guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu'ch vupui bhaan tu' na ja'p bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tattat; gio ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu tanoolh ɨkgiga'n bhaan gu oidha' cham gu Dan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' bɨx dhi' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak jix bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ' gu novɨ bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' gu Yo tu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' kutun kavɨk guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨx dhi' jano' buupui bɨɨx bhai' ñi'ook gu ja'tkam tu' gaagam jano' tu' jix maa na ba' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Israeel guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tattat guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ dhi' aagak gu i'ii'ñ gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu i'ii'ñ tu'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix maa gu mar gu Salomoon gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga ñi'ook kavɨk na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu vaak na ba' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr gu Dabii bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jano' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix bhai' aa' gu Jawatan Dios tattat tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam o'lhia vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar tai bhaan gu tanoolh buimgidhak mambhɨɨx gɨ' ali' vaakax mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chuukug mambhɨɨx gɨ' ali' karneer bɨɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn mui'x makgɨrxi'ñdha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' koi'mɨk guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' jix maa gookim tu jiim guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu mar gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu Sadok guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.

Jano' ba' jix daa gu Salomoon guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' atooxkor gu Jawatan Dios pai' gu Dabii gu taat ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨx gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' bɨx chiñia' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨx gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Salomoon gu vupui bɨx gu Israeel jix maa gɇ'kamtu'nda' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim va'k gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix gɨ'kora' gu Dabii gu mar gu Isaii bhaan bɨx gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jix gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel ka't oo'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' kɨɨv guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix gɨ'kora' gu ebroon guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ vaik jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix koi jix bhai' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix bhuup gu tanoolh namkɨm gɇ'kamtu'nda'; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Salomoon gu mar.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii dharka' jix duu guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga u'uan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Samueel guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Nataan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Gad guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan gu Israeel bhaan bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
